title: How we run projects
subtitle: From the first assessment to the weeks after cutover, this is the sequence every engagement follows.

cards.title: Assessment comes first
cards.description: Every engagement opens with an inventory of both tenants: licensing, identity conflicts, data volume, custom apps. We scope from what’s actually there, not from a template.

cards.title: We map the entire estate
cards.description: Before wave one we know where every mailbox, Teams channel, SharePoint site and Entra ID identity lives, and what depends on what. A dependency nobody mapped breaks the cutover.

cards.title:
We work in
waves
cards.description: Waves are sequenced by business unit, so a bad night stays inside one group instead of the whole company—and every wave carries a rollback we have already tested.

cards.title: We stay after cutover
cards.description: Cutover is not the finish line. We watch mail flow, directory sync, and access, clear the issues users actually report, and leave documentation your team can run from—not a slide deck.
